sources.title: Team Rocket’s Watchtower — Ascended Heroes 210/217
sources.verification: The Stadium text says Colorless Pokémon in play have no Abilities.
sources.supportsZh: 用于 disable_abilities 的“印刷特性仍可见但效果不结算”通用机制；属性筛选、全场持续来源和真实卡时序仍须单独审核。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, community ruling, Japanese local ruling or Chinese translation is used as an international rules authority.
These sources demonstrate effect families only and do not certify the full wording, date, legal format or implementation readiness of either real card.
implementationLimits: disable_abilities and disable_tools each target one server-verified public in-play Pokémon and expire at the source controller's next turn start. Unknown duration, nested text and unverified target data are rejected.

Before applying either suppression, the server rechecks effect protection. Tools stay attached when disabled; active, passive and triggered Ability resolution is suppressed while an ability lock exists.
Ability suppression invokes the shared live-HP/Knock-Out checkpoint, so removal of an Ability-derived HP modifier cannot strand an illegal damaged Pokémon in play.

Global/Stadium source scopes, type or Rule Box filters, exceptions, replacement effects and unaudited real-card bindings remain unsupported. Automatic triggered sources are limited to the reviewed single-target components and bind duration to the printed source controller.
